message.content: The Continental Congress formally adopted the text of the Declaration of Independence on **July 4, 1776**. However, the actual signing ceremony—when the delegates affixed their names to the document—took place a few weeks later, on **August 2, 1776**, at the Pennsylvania State House (now known as Independence Hall) in Philadelphia.
